nodes.name: Note: Bank sync and payment matching

parameters.content:
## Bank sync and payment matching
Reads outgoing bank payments (Plaid), matches them with open bills, and records each matched payment in QuickBooks.

The **core service decides**: which transactions are new, which payment pays which bill (amount tolerance, date window, supplier name or invoice number; accepted only when unique on both sides), and what each QuickBooks answer or failure means. A payment that fits several bills is never applied: it goes to review.

## Start
Every hour, by hand, or by a Run now request. The core returns the saved sync cursor.

nodes.name: Note: Bank transactions, page by page

parameters.content:
## Bank transactions, page by page
Plaid's transaction sync from the saved cursor. The core stores each page; the cursor is saved only after the last page, so a failed run restarts cleanly.

## Sync stopped
A failed step ends the run as failed; nothing is half-saved.

## Matching (core)
The core matches bank payments with open bills and returns the payments to record.

## Bill payments in QuickBooks
One at a time: searched by number first (the core decides: reuse, create or review), created with a fixed request ID, then recorded in the core.

## Payment failures
Facts about the failed step go to the core, which decides: retry on a later run, stop, or review.

## Write-offs of payment differences
Decided by a reviewer on an under-paid bill. A **vendor credit** for the open part ("Payment differences" account), then a **bill payment of 0** that applies it to the bill: the bill is closed, no money moves. Each is searched by its number (AP-WO-…) first, so a rerun never records it twice.

## Write-off failures
The core decides: retry on a later run, or stop and show the error on the review item (which then offers a retry).
